outputs.description: Phonon frequencies for each metal at selected q‑points along high‑symmetry directions.

output_contract.notes: All units and tolerances are defined in the hidden grading specification. The agent must re‑implement the potential fitting and property calculation from the given input tables; it must not rely on pre‑computed parameters from the paper.

steps.description: Check that reported phonon frequencies are consistent with the trace of the dynamical matrix derived from the paper's published force constants.
